open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have aux : ∀ {a b A B}, a ⊆ A ++ [h1] → b ⊆ B ++ [h1] → a ++ b ⊆ (A ++ B) ++ [h1] := by
    intro a b A B ha hb _ h
    grind [List.Subset]
  induction post with
  | const | bvar | op | fvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  | abs _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ | eq _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact aux ih₁ ih₂
  | ite _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact aux (aux ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
  | app =>
      unfold substOld
      split
      · split
        · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
        · exact List.subset_append_left _ _
      · exact aux (by assumption) (by assumption)
